newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN to start telecom services.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN to start telecom services.

text.p: ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp said on Wednesday that subsidiary, ABS-CBN Telecom NA Inc, was ready to launch into the telecommunications market this year.

"We are now poised to offer a full range of telecommunications services in 1997, having acquired significant fibre-optic cable capacity across the Pacific and having finalised arrangements for a switching facility in San Francisco," ABS-CBN International vice president Rene Huergas said in a statement.
The company is targeting the Filipino community abroad. There are an estimated six million Philippine contract workers overseas, of whom 2.5 million are in North America.
ABS-CBN Telecom is licenced by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to provide telecom services in the United States.
The comanIt has started selling pre-paid telephone card products since last year. Huergas said it is preparing to market its pre-paid card products in Europe.
ABS-CBN Telecom provides telecommunications services among Filipino communities in the United States. It already delivered 1.5 million minutes of calls every month to the Philippines.
